eren_vey.note: Bare 'Eren' is rightly not listed (shared with Pell/Eren Vell), though ch2-ch4 narration uses bare 'Eren' for Eren Vey.

pell.note: 'pell' first appears ch2 (ch2 'Pell was lying' even before the name is revealed). 'aven' bare first ch3 ('the Hall called him Aven'); full 'Pell Aven' ch2. All aliases refer only to him. Bare 'Eren' correctly omitted (shared with Eren Vey).

first_house.note: Latch/missing room/Lio chain is only loosely supported: ch5 says the Latch, Mouth Room and Nacre Stair 'were connected rooms and ways of hearing the first house, not the same room' and 'each fragment received one of its names. The Latch was the name Nima heard at the Orchard'. 'The hidden chamber' (the child-sized paper-walled chamber behind the Sump's round door) is called in ch5 'The child-sized chamber beneath the Understair was its memory of being small' -- a fragment, not the first house itself.

ledger.note: ch1 ledger with cracked spine (Tovan's, repairs plus private notes on residents) is probably, but never stated to be, the 'old ledger' of ch3/ch5 that said Alis was buried. first_chapter 1 is fine.

alis_name.note: An inscription (name written on the back of Ivara's sleeping tag), not really an object; harmless.

red_key_tooth.note: Redundant duplicate of red_key (same holder/location rows). first_chapter 1 ('a long iron thing with a forked tooth') vs alias 'key's forked tooth' first literally ch4; harmless but inconsistent. Risk of confusion with seventh_tooth (ch2 says the key is not a comb tooth).

missing: ch5: 'The child-sized chamber beneath the Understair was its memory of being small. The Mouth Room remained a separate answering chamber' -- the hidden/child-sized chamber (ch2-3, ch6) is a separate fragment of the first house; the key folds it into first_house and has no not_same for it.

ch1/ch3/ch5: Mara held the red key before the story ('Her mother had left it'; ch3 'she had taken the red key when the first house became inaccessible'; ch5 'the red key first appeared in her mother's apron') -- no holding for mara.
ch1: Ivara's false belief about Lio ('I took it for a woman's name') appears only as a correction, not in false_beliefs.

ch3: Ivara learns Alis is alive ('I knew she was alive'; 'Tovan had helped hide her') -- knowledge[0] only covers 'not buried'; and Tovan learns nothing new about Pell's identity (ch2 'The porter was the same person') -- Tovan/Ivara learning of Pell Aven's identity as Eren Vell is covered only for Ivara and Eren Vey.
ch4: 'It had never been a door key in the ordinary sense; it was a memory of the hinge that joined the Orchard to the first house' -- red key / hinge relation not recorded.
ch5: Ivara's name is on the stool ('On the stool was her own name, written twice'), Alis's name on 'the chair by the wall': stool ownership/identity of chairs not recorded (and ch6 contradicts).
ch5: Alis: 'I was dead in the register' -- register status of Alis (dead in register; ledger said buried) is a correction not captured.

ch2: ch2 Eren Vey/Pell/Eren Vell naming: ch1 'The two Eren's had learned to answer only to their surnames. When someone called "Eren," both looked up' -- bare 'Eren' is a shared (ambiguous) alias that should be flagged in the key (ch2 'Eren turned it upside down', ch3 'Eren the map and spool' are Eren Vey).

ch6: Alis moves between Hall, first house and Orchard ('She lived where she chose from day to day, sometimes in the Hall, sometimes in the first house, and sometimes among the trees') -- location rows end at Mouth Room.
ch3: Sump: Ivara, Eren Vey, Tovan, Pell are still in the Sump at the start of ch3 ('Ivara took the red key from the stone basin') -- no ch3 Sump locations.

ch1: 'The two Eren's had learned to answer only to their surnames. When someone called "Eren," both looked up.' (self-undercutting).
ch1: Alis Noll written on the tag 'in faded red ink' and 'The letters had faded, but the writing itself was recent'.

Lio = the missing room (= Latch) is stated ch1 ("Lio isn't a person. It's what the missing room calls itself"). Lio is never mentioned in ch5; Lio -> first house depends on Latch = first house, which ch5 itself undercuts ("not all the same room"). Chapter 5 is wrong as the establishing chapter for Lio.

Strong cues for identity (ch3 Tovan "Mara brought her home through the Mouth Room and into the Latch" / "hide her in the first house"; ch4 four children made the room; ch6 Alis "standing in the Latch" behind the First House door). But ch5: "The Latch was the name Nima heard at the Orchard. First House was what Mara called it... The fragments remembered the first house, but were not all the same room." A careful reader cannot settle whether Latch is the whole house or a fragment.

not_same.note: Pair is true (black thread in thimble ch2; blue thread tied round the parcel ch1). Reason text is slightly off: ch1 says only that the hinge pin "bore a faded blue stain", the blue thread does not wrap the hinge pin.
ch2: the comb "had belonged to an earlier keeper of the Hall"; Tovan only claimed to have borrowed it. Distinctness is implied by "earlier", not proven.

ch5: "The Mouth Room remained a separate answering chamber, connected to the first house by a shared wall"; ch3/ch6 agree. Note ch2 contradicts: Tovan "Unless they're the same room" and "Tovan's suggestion was true" (see text_contradictions).

knowledge.note: Nima learns the strip says four children (ch4); "kept one side from falling away" is her own conclusion later in ch4.
ch2 says she had heard the name Pell Aven in an old file; but ch3 Ivara says "I didn't know you had been Pell Aven before that" (text tension).
Night in first house is stated ch3 (Eren finds his name; "spent a single night"); that the spool-name was his own is narrated ch4. He also keeps it secret until ch5.
Voice speaks to the group; Tovan "heard his instruction". Fine.
"everyone_present" is not an entity key; true: Pell states it to Tovan, Ivara, Eren Vey.

false_beliefs.note: ch1: "Nima believed the Latch had been built by Nima's grandmother"; corrected ch4 by her own finding.
Stated ch3 ("Ivara had believed Alis dead and buried"); implied earlier. Near duplicate of [8].
ch1 Eren states door was in a wall that no longer existed; ch5 "had not belonged to a vanished wall, as he had believed".
ch3: "I believed the Latch could not open again... That belief had lasted for years." Sincere; ch6 Tovan calls his claim false.
ch5: "believing it to be an unclaimed tool"; belief runs from ch1 (key left "with no label and no lock") not only from ch5, so from_chapter 5 is late but stated chapter is ch5.

ch3: "Ivara had assumed the phrase meant her sister had not taken a first breath." Falsified in ch3 when Alis is revealed alive; ch5 only explains what "unplaced" meant. corrected_chapter 3 or 5 are both defensible.

ch5 "For years, Pell had believed the porter name was the only one the Hall would let him keep"; already voiced ch3 ("I thought that was what I was allowed to be"), so from_chapter could be 3. ch6 says Eren Vell is "the name he had chosen" (tension).

Never stated as Ivara's belief; only implied by Tovan's correction ch3 ("not your sister by blood"). Ivara asks "Who was Alis to me?" (ch3), which shows uncertainty. ch1 has no kinship statement at all, so from_chapter 1 is unsupported (earliest ch3).

By ch3 she knows Alis was not buried; ch4 narrates it in the past tense ("Ivara had read 'in the niche' as 'buried'... There had been a mistake, then a correction") and "Ivara's remembered claim changed" (ch4), so she no longer believes it in ch4, and the correction is not ch5 (ch5 reveals only that Tovan wrote "buried in the niche"). Contradicts corrections[17] (corrected ch4).
ch2: "He had decided it was his mother's humming, though he had no proof" (weak belief); ch3 "he had stopped believing the song belonged only to his mother".
ch2: "She had never met Pell before he became Eren Vell. At least, that was what she believed." ch3 Pell: "the baby Ivara had slept in a drawer".

5.as_fact: wrong: ch3 'Ivara had assumed the phrase meant her sister had not taken a first breath' is a stillbirth belief (never lived); alis is_alive=false just says she is dead, which collapses into the 'dead and buried' belief (entries 1/8) and loses the not-born-alive content. A fact like born_alive=false / status stillborn would match.

2.corrected_as_fact: wrong: entity door_passage is the 'narrow passage beyond the round door' (ch3), not the door that scarred Eren Vey. ch5: 'The door that had scarred Eren Vey ... was one of the first house's thresholds, folded away when the room divided.' No entity in the key denotes that scarring door, so the fact attaches to the wrong thing (and 'in' is a poor word for 'is a threshold of').

7.corrected_as_fact: wrong: ch2 says Tovan hid the tooth in the false bottom but 'Pell found it there, then moved it beneath the moth' before sending the box (and ch3 shows it tied round the spool under the moth). At the ch4 correction the tooth is not in the false bottom; text establishes only that it was not lost and is kept with the spool/moth in the hidden chamber.

10.corrected_as_fact: wrong: ch1 'Lio isn't a person... It's what the missing room calls itself... the petition had mistaken a room's name for its signer.' The established fact is that Lio is the room's name (first_house name Lio / room is the signer). petition refers_to first_house is a different, uncontradicting relation and does not state the correction of signed_by Lio.

11.corrected_as_fact: wrong: identical to as_fact (officially_sealed). ch2 says 'The passage was still officially sealed, though its door had been painted over'; nothing in the text corrects the claim, so there is no corrected fact (should be null).

10.as_fact: wrong: literal 'the same three notes' is a relative phrase that does not stand alone (same as what?). ch2: 'the thread repeated the same three notes' as the song he heard; the literal should name the song/three notes, e.g. repeats 'the song'.
